prompt: A team wants to call the same set of steps from many workflows in one repository, running inside the calling job with no extra runner. Which construct fits?
explanation: A composite action bundles steps that execute inside the caller’s job on the caller’s runner — no new job, no new machine. A reusable workflow brings its own job and runner, which is exactly the overhead this team wants to avoid.

options.text: A starter workflow copied into each repository
A workflow template with YAML anchors
